items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We just lost a great bass player, Hayes Alvis, just here recently this year.

ctx.x: That's right. You had Walter Fuller but you had George Dixon, you see.
We just lost a great bass player, Hayes Alvis, just here recently this year.

What people don't know, that when Bishop lost the use of his legs, you see, he was mobile. But what they don't know that Bishop was not a drummer. He was a musician, not a percussionist; because Bishop was teaching peoples that you heard about that played in the Milwaukee Symphony. You heard of people that played in the Chicago Symphony.
